name: Foreman
description: Joins a Foreman environment to the tailnet and wires up the secrets, git identity and GitHub credentials Foreman delivers to /run/foreman.

tailscale.description: Install Tailscale and join the tailnet on every container start.

acceptDns.description: Resolve MagicDNS names for connections made through the local Tailscale proxy (127.0.0.2:1055). The container's own DNS is never changed.

dnsCheckHost.description: Unused. Tailscale no longer changes the container's DNS, so there's nothing to check.
